$schema_note: Canonical transect registry for the EARTH observatory pages. Every public cross-section MUST be registered here before it is cited by another page. One row per displayed line. Coordinates are endpoint/pick coordinates in WGS84; chainage is recomputed on the great circle unless stated otherwise.
purpose: Prevent silent cross-domain transfer: a transect may only calibrate interpretations inside its geographic_domain. Outside that domain it is REGIONAL CONTEXT or MECHANICAL ANALOGUE ONLY, never local calibration.

domain_tags.LOCAL_CALIBRATION: may set geometry, depth or timing for features inside geographic_domain
domain_tags.REGIONAL_CONTEXT: frames the tectonic setting; no numeric transfer
domain_tags.MECHANICAL_ANALOGUE_ONLY: process style may inspire hypotheses elsewhere; shortening, detachment depth, drivers and crustal architecture must NOT be transferred without local seismic calibration

transects.name: Kinabalu regional cross-section (dog-leg), Dangerous Grounds → Sabah Trough → Kinabalu Basin → Crocker → Central Sabah → Sandakan → Sulu Sea
transects.geographic_domain: NW Sabah — Kinabalu Basin and Sabah Trough family
transects.chainage_control: 11 WGS84 control points; chainage recomputed 2026-10 geodesically (484.90 km to Mt Kinabalu)
transects.azimuth_by_segment: dog-leg — not a single azimuth; segment azimuths published on the page footer
transects.geometry_lineage: hand-plotted interpretive schematic from published values; NOT machine-derived from survey data; no Moho drawn between 230–540 km chainage (data gap stated on page)
transects.calibration_status: hypothesis board — not a calibrated Earth section
transects.internal_calibrator: KL2 project 8-key-line grid (proprietary seismic; public pages are the hypothesis/boundary-condition layer it tests)
transects.domain_tag: REGIONAL_CONTEXT for Sabah; not usable outside Sabah

transects.name: NW Sabah multi-model crustal transect
transects.geographic_domain: NW Sabah crustal/mantle model space (Dangerous Grounds → Sabah Trough → Crocker → Central Sabah → Sulu Sea)
transects.chainage_control: shares the station chain of T-KIN-XS-833 (11 control points, 484.90 km to Mt Kinabalu)
transects.vertical_exaggeration: depth panel 0–70 km, true-scale depth axis
transects.geometry_lineage: model geometries are parameterised crust/Moho surfaces with runtime geometry hashes; L2 polygons everywhere except sampled topography/bathymetry
data_sources: see page Sources (Gilligan et al. 2026; Pilia et al. 2023; Morley et al. 2023; Cottam et al. 2013; Hall 2013; Sidek et al. 2016; Madon et al. 2025; Tongkul 1997; Tsikouras et al. 2021)
transects.calibration_status: falsification engine running on shared crustal base states — see claims_ledger.json for per-observation georeference state
transects.nested_modifier_note: Models A, F, C share one crustal hash: A = base crust, F = A + shallow ophiolitic sheet, C = A + mantle slab-remnant annotation. They are nested modifiers, not independent Earth states.
transects.domain_tag: LOCAL_CALIBRATION for NW Sabah model space only

transects.name: Deepwater NW Borneo dip transect B–B′
transects.geographic_domain: Baram–North Luconia / NW Borneo fold-thrust belt → NW Borneo Trough → Dangerous Grounds
data_sources: published seismic literature (Hinz 1989; Hutchison 2005; Ogawa & Back 2023; Madon et al. 2015; Morley 2024)
transects.geometry_lineage: bathymetry and gravity sampled at real coordinates (L0); interpreted structure from literature ranges (L2); fault shapes representative, not seismic picks
permitted_analogue_domain: gravity-translation / detachment mechanics as a mechanical analogue
regional setting of the NW Borneo trough
prohibited_transfer_domain: subduction driver arguments to Kinabalu Basin
Sarawak cycle boundaries to SB4–SB8 sequence boundaries without the KL2 crosswalk
transects.calibration_status: valid southern framework; MECHANICAL ANALOGUE ONLY for Kinabalu/Sabah Trough work
transects.domain_tag: MECHANICAL_ANALOGUE_ONLY for Sabah; LOCAL_CALIBRATION for NW Borneo province

transects.name: Deepwater NW Borneo strike transect A–A′
transects.geographic_domain: NW Borneo fold-thrust belt (subparallel to thrust strike)
transects.geometry_lineage: strike line is subparallel to thrust strike: it MUST NOT be structurally restored or read as a dip section (stated on page)
permitted_analogue_domain: along-strike gravity architecture of the fold belt
transects.calibration_status: crustal-thickness gradient signal — compatible with, not confirmatory of, the dip-section architecture (non-unique potential field)

transects.name: KL2 Kinabalu project key-line grid (8 key lines, 80+ wells)
data_sources: proprietary 3D/2D seismic and well databank — NOT public
transects.geometry_lineage: industry seismic lines; the only legitimate local calibration source for Kinabalu geometry
transects.public_role: the three public pages are the hypothesis and regional boundary-condition layer this grid tests; they do not replace it
